_note: Operator-APPROVED fresh daily Bank Builder lanes for the date below. Pinned so the live proposal generator can't silently swap legs after a game kicks off (e.g. England completing). Odds/probabilities are the REAL de-vigged board values from when the lanes were approved; per-leg status is derived at render time from kickoff vs now (pregame / in_progress / awaiting_settlement) — never a fabricated hit/miss. Display + paper only: this file never mutates canonical portfolio.json.

lanes.label: Lane A · Survival (safest)
lanes.whyLadderPick: The two highest-probability draw-protected / favourite legs on the slate, from different games — built to CLEAR a rung, not to swing for a payout.
lanes.whyItCouldFail: Both legs must land — England v DR Congo and Belgium v Senegal going the other way (an upset, a stray goal, or a tight game flipping) loses the rung. Knockout games carry extra-time / penalty variance on 90' result legs.

lanes.label: Lane B · Value
lanes.whyLadderPick: The two best-value legs (model edge over the market price) from different games — a slightly longer price than the survival lane while staying inside a payable band.
lanes.whyItCouldFail: Both legs must land — USA v Bosnia & Herzegovina and Belgium v Senegal going the other way loses the rung. Knockout games carry extra-time / penalty variance.
